content: Link installed and QED already jumped to 0.868. Step 2 gives the other end of the pharmacophore. The cyclobutyl ester at atoms 11-17 is the disposable group - an ester is also the worst thing to leave on a molecule being judged on drug-likeness - and the measured best cap for this series is a cyclopropanecarboxamide, worth about +0.10 of activity over an acetyl while also being QED-positive. Atom 10 is the aromatic carbon bearing the ester carbonyl at atom 11, a non-ring bond, so I cut the whole ester away and attach an N-linked cyclopropanecarboxamide in its place. That puts a conjugated anilide N-H para to the arylamine, which is the arrangement every active molecule I have measured shares.
